# Write actionable implementation tasks

Give the next worker an observable outcome, constraints and useful validation.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use for tickets, acceptance criteria and handoffs that another worker should be able to execute.

Example request:

> Write a task for members to export their own bookings; keep the access restriction and include failure cases.

Expected result: A task with observable behaviour, acceptance criteria, validation and precise dependencies.

## A concrete example

This illustrative example starts from the source facts below.

**Source facts and constraints:** Members may export their own bookings. They may not export another member’s bookings.

**Before**

> Improve export support and validate permissions.

**After**

> Let members export their own bookings. Reject exports of another member’s bookings and verify both outcomes.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.6.0 --skill write-implementation-tasks
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/write-implementation-tasks/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/write-implementation-tasks/references/tasks.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
